They think to rescue you from the Ebruchi victory feast. Instead, they will lose all.''"<br />"''What sort of feast?|Commander Voss Parck and Creysis|<ref name="CD" />}}
The '''Ebruchi victory feasts''' were events celebrated by the [[Ebruchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CD" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Command Decision]]'' are dated to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the Ebruchi [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Creysis]] believed [[Gender/Legends|he]] was the victor of a [[Skirmish between the Admonitor and Creysis's scout squadron|skirmish]] against the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The pirate then told his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]], that the ''Admonitor'' would be unable to save Parck from the forthcoming Ebruchi victory feast. The commander asked his captor what the feast consisted of; however, before the pirate could answer, Creysis was captured by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ebruchi victory feast was mentioned in the short story "[[Command Decision]]", published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11]] in [[November]] [[1996]].<ref name="CD" />
